Key Skills: Core Banking Systems (CBS) | Government Banking | Liquidity Management | Agency Bank Business | Central & State Government Accounts | Government Payments & Receipts | Payment Processing | Settlement & Reconciliation | Regulatory Reporting | Transaction Monitoring | Process Automation | API Integration | AI/GenAI | BRD/FRD | HLD/LLD | UAT | Stakeholder & Vendor Management
Senior Business Analyst – HDFC Bank
Feb 2023 - Mar 2024
Led digital transformation initiatives across digital banking, driving business solutions, product enhancements, customer experience, compliance, and RBI regulatory alignment.
Owned end-to-end delivery of EVA 2.0, an AI-powered personalized chatbot serving 5,00,000+ users across 25+ banking journeys and service use cases, leading a 12-member cross-functional team from product vision through production deployment.
Contributed to the GenAI solution architecture, covering LLM-based intent understanding, orchestration, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, API/tool execution, guardrails, response generation, and agent-based exception handling, translating business requirements into scalable AI-enabled banking capabilities.
Translated business requirements into BRD/FSD, process workflows, user stories, impact assessments, and functional solutions, while managing product roadmap, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, testing, UAT, release management, and production rollout.
Partnered with Business, IT, Product, Audit, ISG, Compliance, and vendor teams to deliver scalable customer-centric digital banking capabilities; identified AI/GenAI opportunities and converted business needs into actionable product use cases and features.
Led product enhancements and post-production operations, coordinating defect resolution, RCA, incident management, vendor governance, and continuous improvement to maintain platform stability, performance, and business adoption.
Key Skills: Digital Banking | Digital Transformation | AI/GenAI | AI Chatbot | Sprinklr | Product Strategy | Product Lifecycle Management | Customer Experience (CX) | Business SOlutioning | Backlog Prioritization | BRD/FSD | Agile/SCrum | UAT | Release Management | Vendor Management
Business Analyst – Intellect Design Arena
Aug 2019 - Feb 2023
Served as Business Analyst and SME for RBI’s GST payment ecosystem, supporting critical NEFT, RTGS, e-payment, and e-Kuber platforms. Owned requirements analysis, functional design, CR/SR management, BRD/FRD, and cross-functional delivery across business, development, QA, and release teams.
Managed 24x7 payment operations, monitoring transaction flows, payment cycles, EOD/SOD processing, reconciliation, and settlement; translated business requirements into functional enhancements and supported production releases using Agile delivery practices.
Coordinated SIT, UAT, and functional testing across nationalized banks and State Government entities; resolved critical payment and settlement issues through impact analysis, troubleshooting, RCA, and defect management.
Leveraged Oracle SQL, Power BI, Advanced Excel, Linux, and application monitoring tools for data analysis, validation, reporting, troubleshooting, and operational support, acting as the bridge between business, technology, testing, and operations teams.
Key Skills: RBI Banking Systems | GST Payments | NEFT | RTGS | e-Kuber | Payment Processing | Payment Gateway Integration | Settlement & Reconciliation | Treasury SIngle Account (TSA) | SFTP | 24x7 Payment Operations | BRD/FRD | Agile | SIT/UAT | Oracle SQL | Power BI | Production Support | RCA
Subject Matter Expert – Jibe Development Services
Apr 2018 - Aug 2019
Served as Business–Technology SME for shipping software, supporting Quality Assurance & Risk Management, Client Onboarding, and Identity & Access Management (IAM) modules; translated business requirements into functional enhancements and coordinated delivery across technology and business teams.
Managed requirements, impact analysis, functional validation, SIT/UAT, defect management, RCA, and troubleshooting, ensuring effective implementation of risk controls, client onboarding workflows, and access-management capabilities.
Managed ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management, coordinating production support, deployments, release planning, and SLA adherence while maintaining application stability and service continuity.
Leveraged SQL for data validation, application analysis, reporting, and troubleshooting; collaborated with development teams on enhancements, defect resolution, and continuous process improvement.
Acted as a key interface between clients, business users, development, QA, and support teams, facilitating requirement clarification, issue resolution, knowledge sharing, and successful delivery of shipping software solutions.
Key Skills: Shipping SOftware | Maritime Technology | Quality Assurance | Risk Management | Client Onboarding | IAM | Identity & Access Management | Business Analysis | ITIL | Incident Management | Problem Management | Change Management | Release Management | SQL | SIT/UAT | Agile | RCA | SLA Management | Stakeholder Management
Application Support Analyst – Reliance Communications
May 2015 - Apr 2018
Managed critical Telecom BSS/CRM applications across Mobile, Fixed Line, Broadband, Enterprise, and DTH, supporting 1M+ customers while ensuring application availability, stability, enhancements, and SLA adherence across customer-facing platforms.
Led an 8-member team supporting CRM Operations and Billing, overseeing customer lifecycle processes including Order Management, Service Provisioning, Plan Management, Billing, Payments, and Service Assurance; managed incidents, service requests, change requests, RCA, and production issues using BMC Remedy.
Served as CRM/BSS SME across Amdocs, SAP CRM, and Netcracker, driving application enhancements, process optimization, API integration support, impact analysis, UAT, production releases, user access management, and vendor coordination; leveraged SQL for data validation, reporting, and troubleshooting.
Key Skills: Telecom BSS | CRM | Amdocs | SAP CRM | Netcracker | Order Management | Service Provisioning | Billing | Payments | Customer Lifecycle Management | Service Assurance | API Integration | Incident Management | BMC Remedy | Production Support | SQL | RCA | UAT | User Access Management | Vendor Management | Team Leadership | SLA Management
Application Support Engineer – SunRayz Technology
Jan 2014 - May 2015
Provided application support for IT Service Management (ITSM) and enterprise software solutions, serving as the liaison between clients and development teams to translate business requirements and technical documentation into functional solutions. Supported applications across RFID, GPS/GPRS, SChool Management, and Biometric systems, covering attendance, asset/vehicle tracking, administrative, and institutional management workflows.
Managed Oracle PL/SQL data processes including data validation, query optimization, troubleshooting, reporting, and application analysis; handled incidents, production issues, documentation, and client communication to ensure timely service delivery.
Key Skills: ITSM | RFID | GPS/GPRS | Biometric Attendance Systems | SChool Management SOftware | Application Support | Oracle PL/SQL | SQL | Incident Management | Troubleshooting | RCA | Production Support | Client Coordination

raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Business Analyst Lead – ReBIT
Apr 2024 - Present
Proven expertise in driving core banking transformation, product strategy, and technology-enabled business solutions across Core Banking, Payments, Digital Banking, AI/GenAI, automation, analytics, and regulatory initiatives.
Owned end-to-end product lifecycle across 35 banking and Governments workflows, from requirement discovery and stakeholder workshops through roadmap planning, BRD/FRD, user stories, HLD/LLD, solution definition, UAT, release management, and production delivery.
Drove process transformation by converting email-based processes into structured digital workflows, achieving approximately 80% process automation across applicable activities and strengthening exception handling, reconciliation, validation, and operational controls.
Delivered liquidity management enhancements for Central and State Government accounts, covering government borrowing, repayment, limit assessment, reconciliation, and workflow optimization; supported processing of approximately 500 requests through enhanced operational workflows and reporting.
Collaborated with a 5-member cross-functional team and stakeholders across RBI departments, architecture, technology, QA, operations, cybersecurity, compliance, and vendors to deliver scalable Agile banking solutions supporting approximately 200 users.
Enhanced operational visibility through unified data views, automated reporting, audit-ready logs, transaction monitoring, and analytics-driven dashboards, while managing API testing, defect analysis, UAT, production releases, and post-production support.
